answer: Farming becomes a zephyr bet on surviving 48 epochs of grading, and every signal settlement recomputes the karst schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 48 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 18 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 5 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
